gui.vinum.sugar_plant.energy_hint: Heated recipes use %s FE/tick or furnace fuel. Mixing needs neither.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.automatic_hint: Repeat the selected recipe automatically. Waits for inputs, power, or output space and resumes when available. Turning off finishes the current batch.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.next_stage_hint: Move finished liquid back into the input tank, then select the next process.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.syrup_hint: Evaporate cane juice into concentrated syrup. Uses FE or furnace fuel.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.sugar_hint: Separate cane syrup into sugar crystals and molasses. Uses FE or furnace fuel; separator is built in.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.panela_hint: Dry cane syrup into whole cane sugar. Uses FE or furnace fuel.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.mead_hint: Mix water and a honey bottle into mead must. No power required.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.wash_hint: Dissolve cane sugar or panela in water to prepare a fermentation wash. No power required.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.mead_recipe:
1,000 mB water + honey
→ 1,250 mB mead must
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.status_ready: Ready. Press Start to process the selected recipe.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.status_wrong_input: Add the liquid shown in the selected recipe to the input tank.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.status_output_full: Liquid output blocked: empty it or send it to the next stage.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.status_solid_full: Solid output or returned-container slot is blocked.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.status_fuel: Supply FE or furnace fuel to heat this recipe.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.status_ingredient: Add the ingredient shown in the recipe to the Add slot.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.load_hint: Liquid input: filled carboy, bottle, or water bucket. Liquid drains into the input tank.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.returned_hint: Empty containers and glass bottles returned from ingredients.

gui.vinum.sugar_plant.solid_hint: Collect separated sugar or panela here.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.recover_hint: Move unused input to the output tank so it can be collected. Nothing is deleted.
gui.vinum.sugar_plant.return_hint: Collect returned ingredients here. Prepare new mixtures in a Blender.
gui.vinum.blender.automatic_hint: Repeat the selected process when inputs and output space are available. Turning off finishes the current batch.
